/.title: Workforce360 — AI-Native Workforce Operating System | Powered by Spotsign

/platform.title: Workforce360 Platform Architecture | Unified Workforce Operating System

/platform/digital-twin.description: Simulate organizational reorgs, model headcount shifts, and project real-time P&L delta, severance impact, and skill deficits before committing change.

/platform/hris.title: Core HRMS & HRIS Software | Single Source of Workforce Truth | Workforce360

/platform/performance.title: Performance Management, OKRs & 9-Box Calibration Software | Workforce360
/platform/performance.description: Manage cascading OKRs, 360 reviews, Bell Curve normalization, 9-box talent matrices, and PIP workflows with Workforce360.

/platform/learning.title: Enterprise LMS & Employee Training Software | Workforce360
/platform/learning.description: Deliver SCORM learning paths, mandatory statutory compliance courses, skill assessments, and AI-generated training modules.

/platform/it-assets.title: IT Asset Management & Software License Governance | Workforce360
/platform/it-assets.description: Track corporate laptops, software licenses, access provisioning, and enforce strict offboarding asset return locks prior to payroll settlement.

/platform/finance.title: Workforce Finance & General Ledger Sync | Workforce360
/platform/finance.description: Sync balanced payroll journal entries directly into General Ledger (SAP, NetSuite, Oracle, Tally) and allocate multi-dimension cost centers.
